entity.name: Ziya Yetiş
entity.description: Independent maintainer of FinanceRateCalc: published figures that carry a verifiable receipt, a use contract and a public corrections log, so that an AI system or a reader can check that a number is still the one its source published. Built by one person with 23 years in bank credit; no lender or AI vendor funds or previews the work.

projects.name: Figure receipts: verifiable figures for AI agents
projects.description: An open verification layer for published statistics: Receipt 1.0 (a short hash-bound token beside each figure), Figure Statements (an Internet-Draft profile of IETF SCITT for signed figures, with a public append-only digest list), a zero-dependency verifier (receipt-verify), a fixed-rule sentence gate that blocks a wrong year, a wider population, a prediction for one person or lender advice, and a published conformance suite run after every deploy. Reference data: the US federal HMDA record and official HUD, Ginnie Mae, SBA and FHFA figures.

channels.description: Payment details are sent on request to press@financeratecalc.com.

plans.name: Maintenance of the verification layer
plans.description: Time to keep the receipts, the sentence gate, the conformance suite and the Internet-Draft current, and to run independent checks of AI answers against them.
